### Catalytic Interfaces

Welcome to the Catalytic Interfaces section of CAAD Futures 2025. This page provides key information for proposers participating in the Catalytic Interfaces programme.

#### Conference Details

- **Dates**: 2–4 July 2025
- **Location**: The University of Hong Kong

#### Key Dates

- **Final Camera-Ready Paper**: <mark>26 May 2025</mark>

#### Requirements
- **Attendance**: At least two Catalysers from each original submission team must attend the conference.
- **Submission**: Please submit directly to [`EasyChair`](https://easychair.org/conferences/?conf=caadfutures2025).
- **Format**:
  - **Template**: Download the paper template in [`DOC or LaTeX format`](https://www.springer.com/gp/computer-science/lncs/conference-proceedings-guidelines).
  - **ZIP**: Package these files in a ZIP folder for submission.
  - **File Type**: Submit both the original file (DOC or LaTeX) and an exported PDF version.
- **Spelling Consistency**: We kindly ask that you use consistent British English spelling conventions throughout your manuscript.
- **Author Details**: Submissions must include author names and institutional affiliations (**do not** anonymise).
- **Contact for Invitation Letters**: Request an invitation letter for travel arrangements by emailing caadfutures2025@hku.hk with your submission ID.
